summary: Indegene has incorporated a step-down wholly owned subsidiary named Indegene Portugal, expanding its corporate structure with a new entity in Portugal.

headline: Arex Industries Q2FY27 net profit jumps 98% YoY
summary: Arex Industries reported a 98.5% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹198.59 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by 13.5% revenue growth and reduced finance costs.

headline: Sacheta Metals Q2FY27 Results
summary: Sacheta Metals Ltd reports Q2FY27 standalone results. Revenue from operations rose 35.7% YoY to ₹28.65 crore, while net profit remained flat at ₹0.50 crore.

headline: Indian Bank pays interest on infra bonds
summary: Indian Bank confirmed payment of ₹356 crore interest on Long Term Infrastructure Bonds Series II. Payment made on Oct 26, 2026, following due date shift.

headline: GSFC Q2FY27: Net loss narrows 37% YoY
summary: Gujarat State Financial Corporation reported a net loss of ₹2,018.75 lakh for Q2FY27, a 36.8% reduction from the previous year. The statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion citing eroded net worth and going concern issues.

headline: Rajkot Investment Trust to consider rights issue
summary: Rajkot Investment Trust Ltd board meeting on Nov 2, 2026, to approve rights issue under SEBI ICDR regulations.

headline: Akme Fintrade secures ₹50 crore term loan
summary: Indian Overseas Bank has sanctioned a term loan of ₹50 crore to Akme Fintrade (India) Limited, enhancing the NBFC's liquidity and funding capacity.

headline: REC Ltd declares ₹3.50 interim dividend, PAT at ₹3,391 crore
summary: REC Ltd board approved Q2FY27 results with net profit of ₹3,391.18 crore and declared a second interim dividend of ₹3.50 per share for FY27.

headline: Sona BLW Q2FY27: Revenue up 35%, PAT up 29%
summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings reported a 35% YoY revenue jump to ₹1,546 crore in Q2FY27. BEV revenue surged 129%, driving strong order book growth to ₹251 billion.

headline: Antelopus Selan Q2FY27 Net Profit Jumps 385% YoY
summary: Antelopus Selan Energy reports ₹5,729 lakh net profit for Q2FY27, up 385% YoY. Revenue rose 116% to ₹12,168 lakh, driven by higher oil production and revised amortization estimates.

headline: Supertex Industries faces ₹18.40 Cr GST demand
summary: Supertex Industries received a GST order from Surat authorities demanding ₹9.20 crore in tax plus an equal penalty. The company plans to contest the order regarding ineligible Input Tax Credit claims.

headline: Antala Industries IPO: ₹16.57 Cr Fresh Issue
summary: Gujarat-based packaging manufacturer Antala Industries files DRHP for a ₹16.57 crore fresh issue. Revenue surged 279% to ₹47.40 crore in FY26, but negative operating cash flows and pending regulatory approvals remain key concerns.

headline: Machino Plastics internal auditor resigns
summary: Machino Plastics Limited announced the resignation of its internal auditor, Goel Garg & Co., citing unavoidable professional reasons. The filing was made on October 26, 2026.

headline: Tata Consumer Q2 net profit up 16% YoY
summary: Tata Consumer Products reported Q2 net profit of ₹4.7 billion, beating estimates. Revenue rose to ₹56.6 billion with EBITDA margin at 13.71%.

headline: Velan Hotels Q2FY27 results
summary: Velan Hotels reports ₹1.29 lakh loss in Q2FY27 after settling debt with ARC. Revenue remains nil as operations are suspended.

headline: Diffusion Engineers CS resigns effective Nov 30
summary: Chanchal Jaiswal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer at Diffusion Engineers Ltd, has resigned citing personal reasons. Her cessation is effective November 30, 2026.

headline: Five Star Business Finance Q2FY27 Results
summary: Five Star Business Finance reports Q2FY27 net profit of ₹299 crore, up 5% YoY. AUM grew 14% YoY to ₹14,640 crore with record disbursements.

headline: HCLTech expands climate grant to 24 countries
summary: HCL Technologies scales its Climate Action Grant program to 24 countries, offering $500,000 to a winner and $250,000 to three runners-up.

headline: Dabur India to host investor meet on Nov 5
summary: Dabur India will hold an in-person analyst and institutional investor meet on November 5, 2026, in Mumbai. The event covers Q2FY27 performance, with no separate earnings call planned.

headline: HEG Advanced Materials appoints Riju Jhunjhunwala as Chairman
summary: Riju Jhunjhunwala appointed Chairman of Malana Power and AD Hydropower, aligning leadership with HEG Advanced Materials' green power platform.

headline: Khazanchi Jewellers board approves EGM for director
summary: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd board approved convening an EGM on Nov 17, 2026, to appoint Simran Lodha as independent director. Voting dates set for Nov 14-16.

headline: Central Bank of India holds investor meet with Tata MF
summary: Central Bank of India management held a virtual one-on-one meeting with Tata Mutual Fund on October 26, 2026. The discussion was limited to public domain information.

headline: Sun TV Network sets Nov 5 record date for interim dividend
summary: Sun TV Network Limited has fixed November 5, 2026, as the record date for its second interim dividend for FY27, subject to board approval on October 30, 2026.

headline: Evonile Pharma appoints Gagan Sharma as SMP
summary: Evonile Pharma Limited (formerly Novartis India) appointed Gagan Sharma as President Specialty Business and Senior Management Personnel effective October 26, 2026.

headline: Euro Pratik puts Fabwood acquisition on hold
summary: Euro Pratik Sales Ltd has paused its proposed ₹42.70 crore acquisition of a 56% stake in Fabwood Solutions LLP, citing matters requiring further consideration.

headline: Elecon Engineering to host investor meet in Chennai
summary: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd will hold a non-deal roadshow with analysts and institutional investors in Chennai on October 30, 2026. The event is hosted by DAM Capital Advisors.

headline: Misun Pure Lights to acquire 10.30% stake in Ishaan Infra
summary: Misun Pure Lights Private Limited and others will make an open offer for 63,48,500 equity shares of Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Limited at ₹14 per share, representing 10.30% of expanded voting share capital.

headline: Kanoria Energy Q2FY27: Profit jumps to ₹304 lakh
summary: Kanoria Energy & Infrastructure Ltd reported a net profit of ₹303.76 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹1.72 lakh in the year-ago quarter, driven by strong revenue growth.

headline: Blue Dart launches US parcel service
summary: Blue Dart Express launches International Parcel Connect for B2C shipments from India to the US, targeting the $2 billion e-commerce export market with DHL-backed logistics.

headline: Bizotic Commercial H1FY27 profit jumps 88% YoY
summary: Bizotic Commercial Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹15.78 lakh for H1FY27, an 88.3% YoY rise. Revenue surged 172% to ₹20.08 crore, driven by trading operations.

headline: Raymond Realty subsidiary secures ₹210 crore from ICICI Prudential AIF
summary: Raymond Realty's subsidiary Ten X Realty West will raise ₹210 crore from ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund to accelerate asset-light expansion in Mumbai.

headline: CP Capital approves corrigendum for warrant issue
summary: CP Capital's committee approved a corrigendum to the EGM notice for its preferential warrant issue. The move follows NSE queries and a new valuation report setting the price at ₹151.44 per warrant.

headline: ASAL Head of IT withdraws appointment
summary: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited announced that Prafullkumar Hulsure withdrew his candidature for the role of Head - IT & Digital, reversing a prior appointment disclosure.

headline: Brigade Hotel Q2FY27 PAT jumps 107% YoY
summary: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd reported a 107% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹2,195 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 10% YoY to ₹13,824 lakh.

headline: AMPL Capital allots warrants to promoter
summary: AMPL Capital (formerly Credent Global Finance) allotted 76 lakh convertible warrants to promoter Aditya Vikram Kanoria for ₹22.8 crore on a preferential basis.

headline: Music Broadcast turns profitable in Q2FY27
summary: Music Broadcast Limited reported a net profit of ₹668.44 lakh for Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue rose 8.2% YoY to ₹4,095.83 lakh.

headline: Novus Loyalty H1FY27 profit up 32% YoY
summary: Novus Loyalty reported a 32% YoY rise in net profit to ₹756.56 lakh for H1FY27. Revenue from operations grew 37% YoY, driven by strong demand.

headline: Rishiroop shareholders approve Batul Shah as director
summary: Rishiroop Limited members passed a special resolution appointing Batul Shah as Non-Executive Independent Director for a five-year term with 99.99% votes in favor.

headline: Thomas Cook subsidiary opens Bandhavgarh resort
summary: Sterling Holiday Resorts, a wholly owned subsidiary of Thomas Cook (India), has opened its new Bandhavgarh property in Madhya Pradesh, expanding its Central India wildlife portfolio.

headline: Rose Merc signs fintech consultancy deal with promoter-linked entity
summary: Rose Merc Limited executed a consultancy agreement with Mohammed Hanif Kasim Shaikh for its Fintech Division. The counterparty is linked to the promoter group via Emirates Holding FZ LLC.

headline: Dindigul Farm seeks Centre nod for MD continuation
summary: Dindigul Farm Product Ltd seeks Central Government approval for R. Rajasekaran's MD role beyond age 70 after AGM vote fell short of statutory majority.

headline: DCM Shriram Q2 net profit falls to ₹1.05 billion
summary: DCM Shriram reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1.05 billion for Q2, down from ₹1.6 billion in the prior year. The company also plans capital expenditure on filter presses.

headline: Baba Arts Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Down 49% YoY
summary: Baba Arts Ltd reported a net profit of ₹17.79 lakh for Q2FY27, down 49.3% YoY as revenue from operations collapsed to near zero.

headline: DCI appoints Grandhy & Co as FY27 auditors
summary: Dredging Corporation of India Ltd has been appointed M/s. Grandhy & Co as Statutory Auditors for FY27 by the C&AG, subject to Board approval.

headline: Eco Hotels launches new property in Maharashtra
summary: Eco Hotels and Resorts Limited launched The Eco Sambhaji Nagar in Maharashtra, adding 52 rooms. The company now operates over 330 rooms, targeting 420 by Q4 FY27.

headline: Grovy India Q2FY27: Net profit jumps 436% YoY
summary: Grovy India Limited reported a net profit of ₹201.83 lakh for Q2FY27, a 436% YoY rise. Revenue from operations surged 79.6% to ₹2,686.84 lakh, driven by strong realty sales.

headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve board to fix rights issue terms
summary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited's board will meet on October 29, 2026, to approve rights issue details. In-principle approvals from BSE and NSE have been secured.

headline: Suncity Synthetics reshuffles leadership
summary: Suncity Synthetics appoints Prajakta Joshi as Additional Director and Vidhi Bafna as CFO, while Suresh Kavarjain resigns from the CFO role.

headline: Aavas Financiers Q2 net profit rises to ₹1.82 billion
summary: Aavas Financiers reported Q2 net profit of ₹1.82 billion, up from ₹1.64 billion YoY, beating estimates of ₹1.81 billion. Revenue grew to ₹7.36 billion.

headline: Tata Consumer appoints Sunil Lobo as India Sales Head
summary: Tata Consumer Products appoints Sunil Lobo as President & Head - India Sales effective Dec 1, 2026. Mahesh Israni retires as Head of Business Integration on Jan 31, 2027.

headline: Page Industries files appeal in Dubai litigation
summary: Page Industries has filed an appeal regarding jurisdiction after a Dubai court dismissed Yellow Flower Trading's claim. YFT also appealed the dismissal.

headline: BGR Energy doubles authorised capital, appoints new WTD
summary: BGR Energy Systems Ltd doubled its authorised share capital to ₹400 crore and appointed Ram Naresh Singh Tomar as Whole-Time Director. Harish Gupta joins as President-Finance.

headline: Bank of Baroda sets analyst meet for Q2FY27 results
summary: Bank of Baroda will host virtual media and analyst meets on October 30, 2026, to discuss Q2FY27 financial results. Management team will present.

headline: Ravinder Heights appoints Vineet Kumar Shrivastava as director
summary: Ravinder Heights Ltd appointed Vineet Kumar Shrivastava as Additional Independent Director and reconstituted key board committees on October 26, 2026.

headline: NCLT sets Dec 14 hearing for Ekam Leasing amalgamation
summary: Ekam Leasing and Finance Co Ltd received an update from the NCLT New Delhi regarding its scheme of amalgamation. The tribunal fixed December 14, 2026, as the next hearing date.

headline: Bajaj Global Q2FY27: Net profit up 84% YoY
summary: Bajaj Global Ltd reported a net profit of ₹10.05 lakh for Q2FY27, marking an 84% year-on-year increase. Revenue from operations rose to ₹19.81 lakh.

headline: Royal Sense promoter clears pledge on 10 lakh shares
summary: Royal Sense Limited clarified a clerical error in its earlier disclosure. Promoter Rishabh Arora's post-event encumbered holding is now Nil after releasing 10,00,000 pledged shares.

headline: AccelerateBS H1FY27 Results: Consolidated PAT surges to ₹171 lakh
summary: AccelerateBS India Ltd reported a massive jump in consolidated net profit to ₹171.26 lakh in H1FY27, driven by strong revenue growth from its US subsidiary.

headline: Achyut Healthcare Q2FY27 Net Profit Falls 63% YoY
summary: Achyut Healthcare reported a net profit of ₹4.95 lakh for Q2FY27, down 63% YoY. Revenue from operations declined 35% YoY to ₹166.08 lakh amid margin pressure.

headline: Automobile Products of India Q2FY27: Net worth fully eroded
summary: The company reported a net loss of ₹46.62 lakh for Q2FY27. Auditors flagged material uncertainty regarding its ability to continue as a going concern.

headline: Trustedge Capital Q2FY27 PAT jumps to ₹48.87 lakh
summary: Trustedge Capital Ltd reported a net profit of ₹48.87 lakh for Q2FY27, up from a loss in the prior year. The board also appointed Suraj Bhadoriya as CFO.

headline: Varroc Engineering acquires 45% stake in Forsee Power India
summary: Varroc Engineering executed definitive agreements to acquire a 45% equity stake in Forsee Power India for up to €4.5 million, strengthening its electric mobility portfolio.

headline: Shoppers Stop invests ₹10 crore in beauty subsidiary
summary: Shoppers Stop completed the second tranche of a ₹40 crore investment in Global SS Beauty Brands, raising total preference shareholding to ₹135 crore.

headline: Promact Plastics Q2FY27 Results
summary: Promact Plastics reports ₹18.89 lakh net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue surges to ₹846.31 lakh from ₹8.13 lakh YoY, driven by trading operations.

headline: Concord Biotech shareholders approve bonus issue
summary: Concord Biotech shareholders passed resolutions for authorized share capital increase and bonus equity shares via postal ballot with overwhelming majority support.
